# Expo native UI (Expo)

Build native-feeling Expo screens with Apple HIG styling, native controls and SF Symbols.

- Source: https://github.com/expo/skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/expo/skills/main/plugins/expo/skills/expo-native-ui/SKILL.md
- Author: Expo
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/expo-native-ui-expo-03d3c6fb

Expo's guidance for building polished mobile screens: Apple Human Interface Guidelines styling, semantic colors, native controls, SF Symbols, media, visual effects, gradients, storage and responsive layouts. It sets code style and library preferences and points to separate skills for routing and animation. References and agent prompts are included.

**Try asking:**
- "Make this Expo settings screen feel native on iOS"
- "Add a blurred header and SF Symbols to my tab bar"
- "Build a profile screen in Expo using native controls"
